newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner unit buys 3M's Media Networks.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner unit buys 3M's Media Networks.

text.p: Time Warner Inc's Time Inc said Wednesday that it acquired the assets of Minnesota Mining and Manufacturing Co's Media Networks Inc unit through a subsidiary for an undisclosed sum.

Stamford, Conn.-based Media Networks produces and sells printed advertising inserts that are bound into issues of national magazines targeted for distribution in local or regional markets determined by postal zip codes. The advertising inserts appear as an integral part of each magazine.

Media Networks will operate as an independent subsidiary of Time Inc and maintain operations in Connecticut. The company said it is expected that employment will be offered to all Media Networks employees.
